MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Aura Resurrect Fix - Hook
MemoryConfigs.Description: RVA 2BC8D0 in sub_1402BC200. Replaces E8CBD9FDFF (call sub_14029A2A0) with E9A3115A01 (jmp cave at 14185DA78). rcx=rdi=pUnit at this point (set by mov rcx,rdi at 2BC8C9).

MemoryConfigs.Name: Charm Aura Resurrect Fix - Cave
MemoryConfigs.Description: PD2-style: save r12/r13/r14/rbp/rax/rdx/r8/r9 (8 pushes). mov r12,rcx (pUnit). sub rsp,50h. call sub_140208330(pUnit)->pInventory. Collect up to 5 inventory items (type=4, [pInv+10h] linked list via [pItemData+0B0h]) into stack list at [rsp+20h]. Then call sub_14020FB30(pInventory,pItem) for each collected item. Restore all regs. mov rcx,r12 (pUnit). call sub_14029A2A0 (stolen). jmp back 1402BC8D5.
